sessions.title: A Collocations about newspapers
sessions.description_vi: Các cụm từ thường dùng liên quan đến báo chí.
sessions.value:
# News

## A Collocations about newspapers

| collocation                   | example                                                                                           |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| a (news) story breaks         | The singer was out of the country when the **story** about his wife **broke**.                            |
| news comes in                 | TV newscaster: **News** has just **come in** of an earthquake.                                            |
| news leaks out                | Although the two stars tried to keep their relationship secret, **news** of it soon **leaked out**.       |
| it hit the headlines          | The scandal is expected to **hit the headlines** tomorrow.                                            |
| make headlines                | A dramatic story like that will **make headlines** world-wide.                                        |
| front-page headline           | The scandal was the **front-page headline** in all the newspapers.                                    |
| the latest news               | **The latest news** from the earthquake zone is more hopeful.                                         |
| be headline/front-page news   | Any story about the Royal Family will **be headline/front-page news** in Britain.                     |
| item of news                  | The main **item of news** today is the earthquake in Broskva City.                                    |
| run a story (publish a story) | The Daily Times recently **ran a story** about an affair between a famous rock star and a politician. |
| flick through the newspaper   | He **flicked through the newspaper** as he didn’t have time to read it properly.                      |

sessions.title: B The language of news stories
sessions.description_vi: Ngôn ngữ được sử dụng trong các bản tin.
sessions.value:
# News

## B The language of news stories

### MINISTER GIVES THE GO-AHEAD TO PLANS

In a surprising turn of events last night, the government agreed to plans for the development of the City. **Interested parties**¹ will hold talks throughout the week.

### ANTI-SMOKING CAMPAIGN

The Minister for Health today outlined plans for a national **anti-smoking campaign**. The government intends to launch the campaign in the new year.

### MINISTER QUITS

The Arts Minister has resigned after only six months in the **top job**. He has attracted attention over his **controversial decision** to **re-introduce charges** for museum entry.

### TOURIST TAKEN CAPTIVE

A tourist was **taken hostage** when **rebel troops** **seized control** of St Pips Airport last night. The government has **lost control** of the area. Our reporter in St Pips is **keeping a close watch** on the situation and we shall be keeping you informed as the **news develops**.

### PEACE TALKS END IN FAILURE

**Peace talks** between the Eastern Liberation Army and the government of Karavia **broke down** last night. **Civil war** is now likely.

### LIGHTNING STRIKES

A building **caught fire** when **lightning struck** a farm in Hampshire yesterday. Fortunately there was no **loss of life**.

¹ people or groups who have a connection with a particular situation, event, etc.

senses.definition_vi: Một câu chuyện tin tức bắt đầu được công bố hoặc lan truyền.
examples: The singer was out of the country when the story about his wife broke.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng để chỉ một tin tức đột ngột hoặc quan trọng.

use_prompts.question: How quickly does news spread on social media today?
How do politicians usually react when a scandal becomes public?
What happens to a company's shares when bad news about it appears?

dictation.text: When a big story breaks, reporters rush to the scene.

paraphrase.source: The singer was abroad when the news about his wife first became public.
paraphrase.model: The singer was abroad when the story about his wife broke.

paraphrase.model: When a big story breaks, journalists work through the night.

senses.definition_vi: Tin tức vừa mới nhận được hoặc được báo cáo.
examples: TV newscaster: News has just come in of an earthquake.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả việc nhận được thông tin mới.

use_prompts.question: How do TV channels deal with unexpected events during a live programme?

paraphrase.model: News is coming in of a big fire in the city centre.

senses.definition_vi: Thông tin mật bị tiết lộ ra ngoài một cách không chính thức.

paraphrase.model: News of the job cuts leaked out before the official announcement.

paraphrase.model: The village hit the headlines after the flood.
